description: This file defines a PHP trait named ETagHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a method to generate ETag values by hashing input data using SHA256 and encoding it with Base64.

classes.name: ETagHelperTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing a method to generate ETag headers from string data.

methods.name: generateEtag
methods.description: Generates a Base64-encoded SHA256 hash of the input data, suitable for use as an ETag value.
